design_principles.fusion: Swiss Poster Typography + Japanese Minimalist Warmth + Modern SaaS Tactile Precision
design_principles.emotion: Clarity, calm control, focus, frictionless productivity without clutter
design_principles.whitespace: Generous 2x-3x padding, high breathing room between list items and sidebar sections
design_principles.one_accent_color: Indigo Accent (#4F46E5 / hsl(243, 75%, 59%)) used exclusively for primary CTAs, active view indicator, and key focus states

typography.font_family_heading: Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit / System Sans (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI)
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro, monospace

rules.overdue_chip: text-xs font-semibold text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5
rules.priority_low: text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 rounded-md px-2 py-0.5
rules.priority_medium: text-xs font-medium text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-md px-2 py-0.5
rules.priority_high: text-xs font-medium text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-md px-2 py-0.5

sidebar.mobile_drawer: Sheet component with left slide-out on screen < 768px
sections: Smart Views: All Tasks, Today, Overdue (with live counts)
Lists Section: Undeletable 'Inbox' + User Custom Lists (with counts & hover actions for rename/delete)

main_content.max_width: max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-8 py-6 md:py-10
main_content.header_row: View Title + Progress Text ('X of Y done') + 'Clear Completed' button
main_content.quick_add_bar: Prominent sticky or top quick-add input with Enter key submit + inline popovers for due date, priority picker, and list selector
main_content.filter_and_sort_bar: Search bar input, Status filter tabs (All / Active / Done), Sort dropdown (Due Date, Priority, Newest)
main_content.task_list: Clean vertical stack with generous spacing (space-y-2.5), subtle hover elevate, interactive check animation, click-to-edit side drawer or modal

edit_panel.type: Sheet / Drawer or Side Panel sliding from right

motion_and_interactions.task_completion: Smooth opacity transition + strike-through text effect
motion_and_interactions.quick_add_submit: Micro pulse & instant insertion at the top of the list
motion_and_interactions.undo_toast: Sonner toast with 5s countdown bar and instant 'Undo' action handler
motion_and_interactions.delete_list_modal: Confirmation dialog ('Are you sure? Tasks in this list will be unassigned/deleted')
motion_and_interactions.empty_states: Contextual friendly vector/icon graphics + encouraging text per filter/view

instructions_to_main_agent: Build backend FastAPI routes in /app/backend/app/main.py or app/routers: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE for lists and tasks, with search/filter/sort logic and undo temporary cache or restoration endpoint.
Default list 'Inbox' must be automatically initialized or ensured in DB and marked is_default=True so it cannot be deleted.
Use Lucide React icons for UI (CheckCircle2, Circle, Calendar, Flag, Trash2, Edit3, Plus, Search, Filter, Inbox, List, AlertCircle, Sparkles, FolderPlus, Menu).
Ensure responsive support down to 390px mobile view with a mobile header hamburger trigger for the sidebar Sheet drawer.
Use Sonner toast component (/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx) for the 5-second Undo task deletion toast.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive components as specified in data_testid_conventions.
